scope: Curated primary-source event records. Not an exhaustive event calendar. Travel markets are explicitly historical annual context, not November/December 2026 forecasts.

events.title: Diwali / Deepavali
events.description: The principal Festival of Lights observance falls on November 8. Celebrations, family gatherings and regional customs extend across several surrounding days.

events.title: Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix
events.dateStatus: 2026 listed on official F1 calendar; recheck organiser updates
events.description: Lusail International Circuit hosts the Grand Prix weekend, with the main race scheduled for November 29.

events.title: Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix
events.dateStatus: 2026 listed on official F1 calendar; recheck organiser updates
events.description: Yas Marina Circuit hosts the Formula 1 race weekend, with the main race scheduled for December 6.

events.title: GITEX GLOBAL
events.description: The GITEX Summit opens December 7 at Dubai World Trade Centre. The expo and conferences move to Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City, December 8–11.

events.title: Pushkar Camel Fair
events.description: Rajasthan's livestock fair combines folk performance, crafts and pilgrimage around Pushkar Lake.

events.title: Sukhothai Loy Krathong and Candle Festival
events.description: Sukhothai celebrates Loy Krathong with candlelit heritage festivities. Consult the local programme for individual performances.

events.title: Vijit Chao Phraya
events.description: Bangkok's riverside light and cultural programme spans November and December.

events.title: Pattaya International Jazz Festival
events.description: A two-day jazz event in Chon Buri, listed on Thailand's official calendar.

events.title: Chichibu Night Festival
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual dates; individual 2026 programme to recheck
events.description: Ornate festival floats, music and fireworks animate Chichibu in Saitama; the principal procession is on December 3.

events.title: Día de los Muertos
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual observance; local event schedules vary
events.description: Families honour deceased loved ones through altars, offerings and cemetery visits. Observe local customs respectfully.

events.title: Festival Internacional del Globo
events.description: Hot-air balloons colour the skies above León during this major balloon festival.

events.title: Nuremberg Christkindlesmarkt
events.description: Nuremberg's Old Town hosts a traditional Christmas market with crafts, seasonal food and festive stalls.

events.title: Vienna Christmas Market at Rathausplatz
events.description: The square before Vienna City Hall becomes a festive market; opening times change on Christmas Eve.

events.title: Lyon Fête des Lumières
events.description: Light artworks transform Lyon's public spaces over four evenings. Sunday hours differ from the other nights.

events.title: International Alba White Truffle Fair
events.description: Alba's food and wine fair celebrates white truffles and Piedmont produce. The truffle market operates on weekends.

events.title: Gijón International Film Festival
events.description: Gijón hosts an international film programme during November.

events.title: Óbidos Vila Natal
events.description: The walled town of Óbidos hosts family attractions, Christmas entertainment and seasonal activities.

events.title: Lucia Day
events.description: Candlelit singing processions mark Sweden's Lucia tradition. Public concerts and venue programmes have separate schedules.

events.title: Lucia at Skansen
events.description: Stockholm's open-air museum presents Lucia processions and singing, including separately ticketed church concerts.

events.title: Bergen Christmas Market
events.description: Festplassen hosts local crafts, gifts and festive food in Bergen's pre-Christmas season.

events.title: Helsinki Christmas Market
events.description: Senate Square brings together Finnish makers and seasonal food around a traditional carousel.

events.title: Lux Helsinki
events.description: Helsinki's light art festival begins in late December and continues into January.

events.title: Tallinn Christmas Market
events.description: Town Hall Square hosts craft stalls and Estonian Christmas food beneath the Old Town's Christmas tree.

events.title: Québec City German Christmas Market
events.description: Old Québec hosts a German-style Christmas market. Usually Thursday to Sunday, with special final-week openings; check the daily schedule.

events.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.description: The 100th edition of the New York parade features balloons, floats and performances on Thanksgiving morning.

events.title: TCS New York City Marathon
events.dateStatus: 2026 confirmed by organiser; occurred before research date
events.description: The five-borough marathon took place on November 1. Retained for complete November context, not as an upcoming event.

events.title: Sydney New Year's Eve
events.description: Sydney Harbour hosts evening and midnight fireworks. Vantage-point capacity and transport arrangements require advance planning.

events.title: Christmas in the Park, Auckland
events.description: Auckland Domain hosts a free outdoor Christmas music celebration with New Zealand performers.

events.title: Dubai Shopping Festival
events.description: Citywide retail promotions and entertainment span Dubai's winter holiday season.

events.title: Beach Canteen, Dubai
events.description: Sunset Beach Jumeirah hosts food pop-ups, workshops and family entertainment during the Dubai Shopping Festival.

events.title: Christmas on A Great Street
events.description: Orchard Road's festive lights and Christmas villages create a seven-week seasonal programme.

events.title: Hong Kong WinterFest
events.dateStatus: 2026 season confirmed; exact opening and closing days unpublished
events.description: The tourism board lists November 2026 to early January 2027 for festive displays, shopping and dining. Exact dates must be rechecked.

events.title: Christmasland in New Taipei City
events.description: New Taipei's seasonal Christmas attraction runs from mid-November through late December.

events.title: Marrakech International Film Festival
events.description: The 23rd edition brings film screenings and cinema conversations to Marrakech.

events.title: Taste of Cape Town
events.description: Green Point Cricket Club hosts a food and lifestyle festival with culinary experiences and music.

events.title: Africa Tech Festival
events.description: Cape Town's business and technology gathering is listed by its convention-centre venue.

events.title: Día de las Velitas
events.description: Families illuminate streets and homes with candles and lanterns on the evening that begins Colombia's Christmas celebrations.

events.title: Día de la Tradición
events.dateStatus: Fixed annual observance; local festival dates vary
events.description: Argentina commemorates José Hernández and gaucho traditions. Local performances and fairs may occur on surrounding days.

events.title: Carols by Candlelight, Gozo
events.description: Gozo presents a candlelit Christmas carol programme; check the event listing for venue and tickets.

GB.label: Historical annual context — Great Britain coverage
GB.note: ONS estimates are statistics in development. These rankings concern Great Britain, not a November/December 2026 forecast.

US.label: Historical annual outbound context
US.note: Mexico and Canada are the largest outbound markets; United Kingdom, Italy and France lead overseas destinations. Overseas counts concern air travellers.

CA.label: Historical annual visitor trips and resident visits
CA.note: Statistics Canada ranks trips and visits, which may include repeated trips by the same person. Not a monthly 2026 ranking.

AU.label: Historical annual short-term border crossings
AU.note: ABS short-term movements are trips under one year, not unique people. Outbound destinations are recorded on resident return.

SG.label: Historical annual visitor arrival source markets
SG.note: STB's three largest arrival markets; no resident-outbound or November/December 2026 ranking inferred.

ES.label: Historical annual international tourist source markets
ES.note: INE FRONTUR measures non-resident tourists arriving in Spain. These are annual source-market rankings.

TH.label: Historical annual tourist nationalities
TH.note: Thai National Statistical Office bulletin reproduces Ministry of Tourism and Sports arrivals by nationality. Not a residence-based or monthly 2026 ranking.

TW.label: Historical annual resident outbound destinations
TW.note: Taiwan Tourism Administration annual report ranks destinations of Taiwanese outbound travellers; mainland China and Hong Kong are reported separately.

ZA.label: Historical annual leading source market
ZA.note: South African government identifies Zimbabwe as its largest source market. Only the leading market is included here.

AE.label: Historical annual international visitor source-market shares
AE.note: Government summary of WTTC: India 14%; United Kingdom and Russia 8% each; China and Saudi Arabia 5% each. Tied markets are not strictly ordered.

JP.period: 2024 calendar year; preliminary estimates released January 2025
JP.label: Historical annual visitor arrival source markets
JP.note: Source: JAPAN NATIONAL TOURISM ORGANIZATION (JNTO). Visitor arrivals include some non-tourist entrants; this is an annual historical ranking, not a monthly 2026 forecast.

IN.label: Historical annual foreign tourist arrivals and Indian national departures
IN.note: Bureau of Immigration data published by India's Ministry of Tourism. Outbound figures count national departures and include purposes beyond tourism; source year is 2023.
